description:
Lock the `gf2-algebra` public API surface against changes by recording an explicit api-freeze checkpoint, gating the W6 Lean verification work on a stable signature set.

## Background

W6 verification (V1, V2, V3) consumes the Charon/Aeneas pipeline against the `gf2-algebra` public surface. Per the verification-work conventions in CLAUDE.md, proof code is brittle to API drift — a Charon regeneration after a signature change can invalidate hours of Lean proof work. This issue records an explicit freeze: the public API of `gf2-algebra::packed::*`, `gf2-algebra::permanent::*`, and the dispatch surface in `gf2-algebra::gpu` (where applicable) is locked against breaking changes for the duration of W6.

This is not a code-changing issue. It produces a written sign-off doc that lists the locked symbols, references the W6 Lean issues that consume them, and establishes the change-control protocol (subsequent breaking changes require explicit user approval and re-verification of impacted V1/V2 proofs).

## Success Criteria

- [x] [hard] `dev/plans/gf_api_freeze_w6.md` exists and is attached via `jit doc add`, listing every public symbol locked under the freeze.
- [x] [hard] The doc names the W1-W5 issues (T13, T15, T18, T20, T26) whose surfaces become frozen.
- [x] [hard] The doc establishes a change-control rule: post-freeze breaking changes require explicit user approval AND a corresponding update to V1/V2/V3 if they consume the changed symbol.
- [x] [hard] User has signed off on the freeze checkpoint (recorded as an `## Approval` section in the doc and in this issue's description).

## Approval

Approved by: vesa.kaskivuo@iki.fi
Date: 2026-05-14
Mechanism: AskUserQuestion confirmation, session 8 of epic `ae82bd73`, option \"Approve as-is\" of the four-option freeze sign-off menu.

Locked-symbol list, W6-consumer mapping, and change-control protocol live in the design doc `dev/plans/gf_api_freeze_w6.md`. The attached commit pin is rolled forward on each correction; current pin: `7c634620` (2026-05-15 session 9 — canonical-path fix for `packed::packed7::LANES` and explicit out-of-scope section for the cfg-gated placeholder modules `parallel`, `gpu`, `testutil`). The GPU dispatch surface freeze is explicitly deferred until `2fbbdfa5` (host dispatcher) lands; W6 Lean work does not consume the GPU surface, so this deferral is non-blocking for W6.
